home.title: Welcome to Nexiqon Studio
home.subtitle: Set up an assistant that answers from your {knowledge} and hands off to your team when it should.
home.stepsHint: Follow these steps to put your first assistant in front of users.

tiles.invite: Bring your team in and set their roles
tiles.key: Connect your backend or website widget
tiles.audit: See every change, verify nothing was altered

home.allDone: All set. Your assistant foundation is ready.

comingSoon.title: {section} is coming
comingSoon.body: This part of Studio is being built. You will be able to {what}.
comingSoon.whatYouCanDo: Meanwhile you can manage members, API keys, configuration and the audit log in Settings.

sections.assistants: create assistants from a Domain Pack, tune their behaviour and publish versions safely
sections.knowledge: add websites and files, watch them being indexed and control who can see what
sections.playground: test answers with citations and see exactly why each answer was given
sections.conversations: review conversations, rate answers and handle escalations
sections.insights: see quality, content gaps, usage and cost
sections.evaluations: build test sets and compare versions before publishing
sections.domainPacks: edit vocabulary, intents, prompts and guardrails without code
sections.actions: connect your APIs as tools with safe confirmations
